title: Radial retraction onto the closed unit ball is nonexpansive towards points of the ball
statement: Let E be a real inner product space and x, y ∈ E with ‖y‖ ≤ 1. Then ‖(max 1 ‖x‖)⁻¹ • x − y‖ ≤ ‖x − y‖.
lean_statement: ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (x y : E), ‖y‖ ≤ 1 → ‖(max 1 ‖x‖)⁻¹ • x - y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖
